newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products mixed, mogas weaker but uncertain.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, mogas weaker but uncertain.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday morning, with heating oil rising in line with futures, while gasoline came off, dealers said.

Gasoline was $1/$2 a tonne weaker, although the market was at a standstill with no early deals and a wide bid-offer spread. Offers for prompt Rotterdam refinery material were at $188 fob, but bids were at least $2 lower.
Traders said many in the market were waiting for the resumption of business in the U.S. after an extended weekend, to reassess levels.
"You could say it's weaker. Really, it's just dead," one trader said.
Heating oil barges gained about $1 as IPE July gas oil futures firmed. Prompt offers remained at around IPE July +75 cents.
Some traders said diesel could strengthen from July +$6 fob Rotterdam offered, with supply seen limited.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded once at $86 early on Monday and were then offered at $87 fob Rotterdam. By late morning, offers dipped to $86/$86.50, little changed from Friday's close.
